environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed within VPC (subnet-0a3f8c, subnet-0b7d2e in us-east-1a/1b). API Gateway is configured as PRIVATE REST API with a VPC Endpoint policy that restricts invoke access to vpce-0x8a3b91cf2d (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.execute-api). The VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering connections. Route tables for the Lambda subnets contain only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and the S3 gateway endpoint route. DNS resolution is handled by Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint within the VPC. The VPC endpoint policy on vpce-0x8a3b91cf2d restricts access to principals within the AWS Organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). Security groups on the VPC endpoint ENIs allow inbound HTTPS (443) only from CIDR 10.0.48.0/20 (internal application subnet). No public DNS name is published for the private API stage.

config.vpc_endpoint_policy: Allow execute-api:Invoke only where aws:PrincipalOrgID = o-a1b2c3d4e5
config.route_tables: local only (10.0.0.0/16) + s3 gateway endpoint prefix list
config.s3_access: via gateway endpoint (vpce-s3) with policy restricting to bucket ARN
